title: The European tour
summary: He enjoyed the European trip though everyone wanted to get home to unpaid bills.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So how was, you enjoyed the European thing?

Oh yeah, I really enjoyed it. I just... If you'd... I was hoping it had been... Longer. Yeah. Well, in a way it could have been longer. Really I wouldn't know what to say about it. We enjoyed it and everybody was happy and everybody was anxious to get back home because they had bills and things that was undone to be taken care of here. Doesn't everybody. It don't blend in when you're away from home. My wife writing for money. While you were gone? Yeah. When I made the error of not leaving her, it was there but she couldn't use it because it was in checks, you know. Oh. I didn't catch them before I left.
